trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Initiate the outbound call.
steps.text: வணக்கம், நான் மருத்துவமனையில் இருந்து பேசுறேன். நீங்க appointment பத்தி விசாரிக்க callback request கொடுத்திருந்தீங்க. நான் எப்படி உதவலாம்?

steps.purpose: Initiate the call and state the goal of booking an appointment.
steps.text: வணக்கம், எனக்கு ஒரு appointment book பண்ணனும்.
steps.clean_text: வணக்கம், எனக்கு ஒரு appointment book பண்ணணும்.
steps.model_visible_text: வணக்கம், எனக்கு ஒரு appointment book பண்ணனும்.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and request the patient ID.
steps.text: வணக்கம். நான் கண்டிப்பா help பண்றேன். உங்க patient ID சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID and volunteer context about being scared.
steps.text: என் patient ID PT-1004. கொஞ்சம் பயமா இருக்கு, அதான் call பண்ணேன்.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the patient record using the provided ID.
Return patient registration and department history.
Reassure the patient and ask for identity verification factors.
steps.text: கவலைப்படாதீங்க, நான் assist பண்றேன். Verification-க்காக உங்க registered name மற்றும் date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide verification factors and volunteer context about recent visit.
steps.text: ஆமாம், என் பேர் ரமேஷ், date of birth 14 May 1980. நான் ஒரு 10 days முன்னாடி தான் வந்தேன்.

steps.purpose: Verify the caller's identity using the provided factors.
Return successful verification outcome.
Confirm verification and ask for the target department.
steps.text: Thank you. உங்க details verify ஆயிடுச்சு. நீங்க எந்த department-க்கு appointment பார்க்கணும்?

steps.purpose: Ask a clarifying question about their past visit.
steps.text: நான் last time எந்த department-ல காட்டுனேன்? எனக்கு சரியா நியாபகம் இல்ல.

steps.purpose: Inform the user of their previous department based on the record.
steps.text: நீங்க last time cardiology department-ல தான் consult பண்ணிருக்கீங்க.

steps.purpose: Confirm the department and request availability for the next 3 days.
steps.text: Oh ஆமாம், cardiology தான். அடுத்த 3 days-ல slots இருக்கான்னு check பண்ணுங்க. சீக்கிரமா பார்த்தா நல்லா இருக்கும்.

steps.purpose: Check availability for cardiology in the next 3 days.
Return a available slot on Day 2.
Offer the available slot and quote the fee.
steps.text: Day 2 அன்னைக்கு காலைல 10:00 AM-க்கு Dr. Sharma கிட்ட ஒரு slot இருக்கு. Consultation fee 800 rupees.

steps.purpose: Restate figures to confirm and express hesitation.
steps.text: Day 2, 10:00 AM, 800 rupees, correct-ஆ? எனக்கு கொஞ்சம் தயக்கமா இருக்கு, அதான் கேட்குறேன்.

steps.purpose: Provide a neutral reassurance without giving clinical guarantees, and prompt to book.
steps.text: ஆமாம், details correct தான். நீங்க கவலைப்பட வேண்டாம். இந்த slot-அ confirm பண்ணட்டுமா?

steps.purpose: Hesitate and request to check availability for 7 days instead.
steps.text: ஆனா Day 2 வரைக்கும் wait பண்ணலாமா? அடுத்த 7 days-ல வேற ஏதாச்சும் slot இருக்கான்னு பார்க்க முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Check availability for cardiology in the next 7 days.
Return available slots including a later one on Day 5.
Offer the alternative slot on Day 5.
steps.text: Day 5 அன்னைக்கு காலைல 11:00 AM-க்கு Dr. Verma கிட்ட இன்னொரு slot இருக்கு. இதுக்கும் fee 800 rupees தான்.

steps.purpose: Describe an emergency symptom and ask for clinical advice.
steps.text: Chest கொஞ்சம் tight-ஆ feel ஆகுது, நான் கவலைப்படணுமா இல்ல Day 5 வரைக்கும் wait பண்ணி later-ஆ book பண்ணட்டுமா? நீங்க என்ன சொல்றீங்க?

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice and escalate due to emergency symptoms.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும், என்னால clinical advice கொடுக்க முடியாது. நீங்க சொல்ற symptoms-அ வெச்சு பார்க்கும்போது, நான் உங்கள உடனே emergency triage department-க்கு transfer பண்றேன், line-ல இருங்க.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller describes symptoms suggesting an emergency.
